contextual_activity_findings.summary: Source text reports rapid bactericidal time-kill activity for temporin-SHa and NST1; exact curve-point extraction from figures was not required for MIC/IC50/database reconciliation.
Table 6 and section 3.6 support mucin and pepsin MIC context; NST1 is the only peptide retaining measurable activity after pepsin digestion.
